purpose: Demonstrates the private-input screening shape: screens a privately held party/transfer list against a fixed three-name synthetic test list by substring match, and emits a public verdict (screened, hit count, clean flag) without disclosing the party list. It is a demonstration of the screening shape, not a sanctions screen; the list version is a label the caller supplies, not bound to any list bytes. Carries an OCG Standard §25 ocg-private-input@1 declaration: the party list is committed via sha256-salted@1 in policy_parameters.parties_commitment, never in the clear. Private-input variant of screen_tip20_transfer_batch (art-38); use that public-input kernel when disclosure of the party list is acceptable; use this one when it is not. ZERO PII disclosed: only the verdict is public.
